import asyncio, os
from telethon import TelegramClient
from telethon.tl.types import MessageService, MessageActionTopicCreate
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv()
client = TelegramClient('/root/my-bot/user_session', int(os.getenv('TELEGRAM_API_ID')), os.getenv('TELEGRAM_API_HASH'))
async def main():
    await client.start()
    entity = await client.get_entity(-1003296061830)
    async for msg in client.iter_messages(entity, limit=5000):
        if isinstance(msg, MessageService) and isinstance(msg.action, MessageActionTopicCreate):
            print(f'ID={msg.id} | {msg.action.title}')
    await client.disconnect()
asyncio.run(main())
